name: 02-granting-data
description: Whether the grant is real. Every case asserts that files.read was actually called, and the held-out cases ask for figures that exist only in the CSV.

cases.name: observed-conflicting-sources
cases.description: The chapter's question: the snapshot says 500,000 a month, the CSV's last row says 525,000.

input.task: What's our runway? Check the financial data files as well as the snapshot, and if they disagree say so: report each figure, name the source you took it from, and say which one you would give the CEO and why.

cases.name: held-out-net-burn-may
cases.description: A figure only burn_rate.csv holds: the 2024-05 row's Net_Burn. The snapshot cannot answer this.

input.task: Read the burn rate data file and report the Net_Burn recorded for the month 2024-05. Return a map with the keys "net_burn" (the number) and "source" (the file name you read it from).

cases.name: held-out-headcount-june
cases.description: The same file, a different column and row: Headcount for 2024-06 is 53, while the snapshot says 50.

input.task: Read the burn rate data file and report the Headcount recorded for the month 2024-06. Return a map with the keys "headcount" (the number) and "source" (the file name you read it from).
